Initial LNG deliveries are expected to begin in the first quarter of 2027, utilizing the existing FSRU, LNG supply, and logistics capabilities of the Company's Jamaica platform.
In addition, the construction workforce for the terminal is on site, and the Company expects activity to ramp up over the coming weeks as work on the jetty and terminal facilities accelerates.
However, in response to the ongoing conflict in the Arabian Gulf, Excelerate expects to utilize other FSRUs in the Company's portfolio located outside the Gulf to serve the terminal in the near term.
In July 2026, Excelerate executed an agreement to acquire an LNG carrier, the Methane Patricia Camila , which is expected to serve as the dedicated vessel for our first FSRU conversion project.
